summary: The Stanley Parable entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The Stanley Parable
entries.definitive_edition: Original 2013 Steam release for historical route; Ultra Deluxe for expanded modern route

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original 2013 PC build and/or Ultra Deluxe branch with build recorded

primary.version: Original 2013 Steam release plus Ultra Deluxe as expanded modern branch
primary.why: The original 2013 standalone is the historical fidelity route, while The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe is the current expanded remake/sequel-style route with substantial new content and console support. Archive both branches rather than treating Ultra Deluxe as a simple patch.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original 2013 Steam release for historical endings/Source-engine behavior, then document Ultra Deluxe separately if playing the expanded route. Record branch, build, ending path, achievement/date-sensitive behavior, narrator/audio settings, and whether 2011 mod content was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Expanded 2022 remake/sequel-style release with new content and platforms
secondary.what_to_play: Use after the original route when documenting the modern expanded branch.
secondary.why: It changes and expands the work enough to label separately.
The 2013 standalone is the primary original-game route.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded modern branch with new content and console support.
all_releases.reason: primary: expanded route, but distinct from the original 2013 build.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Ultra Deluxe is the richer modern route, but the original 2013 build remains necessary for exact historical behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: Label Ultra Deluxe separately and record branch-specific endings/achievements.
